shared_elements: low relief carving with figures on a plain ground
register or band organization with a horizontal dividing line
frieze/border of repeated small motifs (rosettes in A, hieroglyph-like signs in B)
figures facing one another / interacting across the scene
justification: Both are low reliefs with profile human figures arranged along a horizontal register bounded by bands of repeated small motifs, which is a generic convention rather than a distinctive shared scheme. A shows a large standing camel led by a walking attendant with a staff on a monumental frieze, while B shows two seated figures facing each other across an offering table above lines of script-like signs — the subjects, postures and combinations are quite different.
